tickets.title: Evaluate Paper Otter Life policy lapse and reinstatement
tickets.text: Evaluate lapse and reinstatement options for Soren Cloudpuddle's $750,000 20-year Paper Otter Life term policy after the monthly premium draft from Teacup Comet Bank checking failed when the account was replaced, before existing underwriting terms are lost.
tickets.evidence: 2024-12-13 agreed: evaluate lapse/reinstatement after notice showed draft failure when checking was replaced, before losing existing underwriting terms.

tickets.title: Review term life and disability coverage for Cloudpuddle household
tickets.text: Review term life and disability coverage for Soren and Lila Cloudpuddle after Lila reduced paid work to part-time, given the $620,000 primary-residence mortgage, childcare for dependent child Rowan Cloudpuddle (6), and education-funding exposure now concentrated on Soren's salary.
tickets.evidence: 2024-12-20 agreed: review term-coverage/disability-protection after Lila reduced paid-work to part-time, increasing household dependence on his salary, with mortgage/childcare/education-funding exposure.
